correctness.rationale: Explicit 16-vertex graph definitions and all 560 three-subsets fix a finite exact Hamiltonian. The standard-library closed-walk recurrence and independent integer sparse-matrix powers both produce common traces through order seven and order-eight difference 2193408; an exact identity 2193408/(560*40320)=17/175 establishes the analytic first coefficient. Exact dimension and normalization were independently checked.

value.rationale: The first nonzero high-temperature and short-time normalized trace coefficient is a motivated physical spectral invariant. These two canonical cospectral SRGs are provably indistinguishable by their single- and two-token spectra, yet even their three-particle traces agree for seven moments. The sharp eighth-moment cutoff and exact 17/175 coefficient quantify an otherwise invisible many-body response and furnish a natural finite benchmark rather than an arbitrary slice of a known polynomial.
